'''U-Tendik''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] used as a refuge by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Tetsu Clan]]. The landscape was dominated by tall [[Tendril tree]]s, which bore large nuts of the same name. The Rodians [[Nok (Rodian)|Nok]] and [[Teeku]] herded arboreal creatures known as "[[Tree-Bott]]s" for [[Milk/Legends|milk]] and meat. Other native creatures included [[bo-toad]]s and [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cats]].
